subject: English
passage: Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms through chemical reactions within their bodies. This phenomenon allows organisms to create their own light without any external energy source. Among marine fish, bioluminescence has been documented in numerous species, including deep-sea anglerfish and lanternfish. When researchers at the Monterey Bay Aquarium analyzed water samples from their deep-sea exhibit, they discovered light emissions coming from areas where no known bioluminescent fish were present. However, microscopic examination revealed the presence of previously unidentified microorganisms in those same areas. Thus, the scientists concluded that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: at least one of the larger fish species in the exhibit had consumed bioluminescent microorganisms.
choices.B: the unidentified microorganisms were probably producing the observed light emissions.
choices.C: microorganisms may exhibit bioluminescence in aquarium settings but not in their natural ocean habitats.
choices.D: microorganisms develop bioluminescence only when they lack sufficient access to natural sunlight.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of bioluminescence as it relates to the discovery at the Monterey Bay Aquarium. The text explains that bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions within their bodies, allowing organisms to create their own light. After noting examples of bioluminescence among marine fish, the text then reports on a discovery at the aquarium. According to the text, researchers found light emissions in areas where no known bioluminescent fish were present, but microscopic examination revealed previously unidentified microorganisms in those same locations. Given that bioluminescence allows organisms to produce their own light and these microorganisms were found precisely where unexplained light was observed, it can reasonably be inferred that the scientists concluded the microorganisms were most likely the source of the mysterious light emissions.
